business_summary: Jiangsu Leili Motor Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of household appliances, micro motors, and intelligent components in China and internationally. It offers air conditioning motors and components comprising air guide motors and mechanism components, and brushless motors; washing machine motors and components consisting of drain motors and pumps, and dispensing system components; refrigerator motors and components, such as chiller motors and pad, crusher motor, and maker systems; and small appliance motors and components, including stepper motors, and brushless DC motors and components. The company also provides automotive motors and parts, such as head-up display motors, electric air-conditioning compressors motor assemblies and aluminum die-castings, electronic water pumps, precision stampings, and supporting parts; medical and sports health motors and components, such as lead screw and voice coil motors, and treadmill motors and components; industrial control motor and components, including industrial water pumps; laser radar motors; electric-air machines and components; synchronous and DC brushed motors; and micro water pumps. In addition, it is involved in investment and asset management; and commerce and trade activities. The company was formerly known as Changzhou Leshi Leili Motor Co., Ltd. Jiangsu Leili Motor Co., Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
